# Smart Business AI

> An applied-AI studio designing and shipping intelligent software for engineering, manufacturing and product teams.

Smart Business AI (smartbusinessai.co.uk) is a UK-based applied-AI studio building production-ready intelligent tools end-to-end — research, design, code, deployment. The studio focuses on domain-specific AI assistants for industries that have been historically underserved by generic AI tooling: precision manufacturing, hydraulics and engineering, root cause analysis, agentic app deployment, and personal knowledge interfaces.

The portfolio includes six live AI products. Each is built by the same operator who has worked in the problem domain it serves.

## Apps

- [RCA Flow](https://smartbusinessai.co.uk/apps/rca-flow): AI-assisted root cause analysis. Guided 5-Whys and Fishbone canvases with AI hypothesis generation and cross-incident pattern detection.
- [M32 Citizen CNC Program Analyser](https://smartbusinessai.co.uk/apps/m32-cnc-analyser): CNC program assistant for Citizen M32 sliding-head lathes — explains G-code, suggests cycle-time improvements, drafts programs from blueprints.
- [Ship It — App Builder](https://smartbusinessai.co.uk/apps/ship-it): Agentic AI that takes a product idea and writes, packages and deploys a complete web application to Vercel.
- [Hydraulics Calculator](https://smartbusinessai.co.uk/apps/hydraulics-calculator): Precision calculator for hydraulic engineers — pressures, flows, orifice sizing with imperial/metric handling.
- [PRD Builder](https://smartbusinessai.co.uk/apps/prd-builder): Generates a complete Product Requirements Document plus a tuned CLAUDE.md planning file for agentic downstream builds.
- [Liam's Digital Twin](https://smartbusinessai.co.uk/apps/liam-digital-twin): AI version of Liam, tuned to answer questions about his career and projects in natural conversation.

## Insights

- [Building agentic tooling that real businesses will actually use](https://smartbusinessai.co.uk/blog/building-agentic-tooling-for-real-businesses): Lessons from shipping AI into manufacturing, engineering and operations.
- [From PRD to deployed app in a weekend](https://smartbusinessai.co.uk/blog/from-prd-to-deployed-in-a-weekend): How a tight PRD + a tuned CLAUDE.md collapses the gap between idea and live software.
- [AI in the machine shop](https://smartbusinessai.co.uk/blog/ai-in-the-machine-shop): Why CNC programming is the perfect proving ground for domain-specific AI assistants.
